description: Longitudinal Cyber-Physical Anomaly Detection Dataset (LCPADD) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors DURE ADAN AMMARA, KURT TUTSCHKU (Blekinge Institute of Technology). LCPADD is a longitudinal cyber-physical dataset captured from five operational secondary substations in Southern Sweden over a six-month period. The dataset addresses the scarcity of real, high-fidelity operational data for smart grid cybersecurity research, which often relies on synthetic traffic or short-duration testbeds. Coverage: national (SE); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
